"Aage Aage Tum Chalo Pichhe Pichhe Hum" is a lively and playful duet from the 1995 Bollywood film Ab Insaf Hoga, featuring Mithun Chakraborty, Deepila Amin and Rekha. The song is performed by Abhijeet Bhattacharya and Sadhana Sargam, with music composed by Anand-Milind and lyrics penned by Anand Bakshi.
